pr_title: PR #479 + minimal review_lever to avoid template lock
pr_description: Same as PR #479 but with one tweak to fix its biggest regression: The tweak: Strip `review_lever` field description to `"Critical review of this lever (one sentence, 20–40 words)."` — no structural phrase. Section 4 preamble becomes just `"A one-sentence critical review. Examples:"`. The three existing examples teach the style without a copyable template. Why: PR #479's `"the proposed options collectively do not resolve"` caused qwen3-30b to lock (0→7/20) and worsened gpt-oss-20b (10/17→15/17). Every structural phrase becomes a fill-in-the-blank template for small models. From #479 (unchanged): verbatim numbers on consequences+options, positive framing, consistent 2-3 sentence targets, section 5 prohibition.
